messages:
maria: quick triage note — after yesterday's batching heuristic tweak i see a regression on streaming p50 for hosted flows. host-side overhead (tokenize+parse+framing) up ~6-12ms.
maria: attaching the short flame and a small log I grabbed from the edge host :eyes:
maria: ```
# perf summary (sampling 30s)
CPU  62% user  18% system
host_parse_tokenize  28%  p50 9.3ms -> 14.8ms
grpc_writev            12%  avg calls/request 4.7 -> 9.1
kv_prefetch_task        6%  triggered on small requests
other (io/syscalls)    16%
```
joel: is this only for streaming endpoints or we see same on short sync calls?
joel: checked traces — streaming shows extra framing+writev churn when batcher emits small micro-batches (1-2 reqs). sync calls unchanged.
ash: likely the new batching heuristic (slot-based) tries to pack latency-SLO paths aggressively => more micro-batch wakeups. that matches higher writev count.
ash: also saw KV prefetch enabled in deploy yesterday for "smart-cache" — it does async prefetch on incoming parse tokens which can add CPU and syscalls if not gated.
maria: yeah the prefetch flag was flipped in canary: `feature.enable_kv_prefetch = true` at 2026-02-10T03:14:22Z (infra-bot deploy log below)
infra-bot: deploy event: service=edge-proxy commit=c3f4a7a env=prod canary=true by=infra@redwood
kai: quick mitigations we can try:
- gate kv_prefetch by stream size: only prefetch for >2KB payloads
- coalesce writev in host-proxy: buffer framing writes for up to 200µs or 1KB
- fallback batching threshold: if micro-batch rate > 30/s, switch to old time-window packer
kai: example coalesce patch (pseudo):
kai: ```diff
- socket.writev(frames)
+ buffer.append(frames)
+ if buffer.size >= 1024 or buffer.age >= 200us:
+     socket.writev(buffer.flush())
```
joel: sounds good. which one is lowest risk to rollback quickly?
kai: flipping kv_prefetch -> false for canary is trivial and safe. coalesce patch needs a small bench but should be fine.
sre-oncall: noticed increase in SLO alerts for streaming p50 last 6h, escalation opened. marking priority-high. :warning:
maria: plan: revert kv_prefetch in canary now, monitor p50; if still high, enable coalesce in next patch and toggle batching back to time-window for affected hosts.
maria: I'll run a quick canary revert now and post results in 10-15m. ping me if you want to join the debug session :thumbsup:
joel: thanks — i'll pull traces and check KV hit patterns once revert is up.
ash: i'll start a micro-bench harness for coalesce patch, will push numbers to the PR.
infra-bot: deploy rollback: service=edge-proxy commit=c3f4a7a -> reverted feature.enable_kv_prefetch=false by=infra@redwood
maria: update (10m): canary p50 back down ~7ms, writev calls per request halved, CPU profile shows kv_prefetch gone from 6% to ~1%. looks promising.
maria: next: schedule coalesce + safe batching rollback on small subset tomorrow, keep monitoring.
